title: In the Days of the Judges
text: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land.

title: A Famine in the Land
text: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land.

title: Mahlon and Chilion
text: The man’s name was Elimelech, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion.

title: Without Her Sons and Husband
text: … and Naomi was left without her two sons and without her husband.

title: The LORD Provided Food
text: When Naomi heard in Moab that the LORD had attended to His people by providing them with food …

title: On the Road to Judah
text: Accompanied by her two daughters-in-law, she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road leading back to the land of Judah.

title: Go Back to Your Mother's Home
text: Go back, each of you to your mother’s home.

title: They Wept Aloud
text: And she kissed them as they wept aloud …

title: Too Old for Another Husband
text: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband.

title: Orpah Kissed Her Goodbye
text: Again they wept aloud, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.

title: Ruth Clung to Her
text: … but Ruth clung to her.

title: Wherever You Go
text: For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live …

title: Your People Will Be My People
text: … your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.

title: Where You Die, I Will Die
text: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried.

title: Ruth Was Determined
text: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her.

title: The Whole Town Was Stirred
text: When they entered Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them …

title: Call Me Mara
text: Do not call me Naomi, | Call me Mara, because the Almighty has dealt quite bitterly with me.

title: Brought Back Empty
text: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty.

title: The Beginning of the Barley Harvest
text: And they arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.

title: Let Me Glean
text: Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.

title: Find Favor
text: “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.

title: The Field of Boaz
text: And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.

title: The LORD Be with You
text: The LORD be with you.

title: Whose Young Woman Is This?
text: Whose young woman is this?

title: The Moabitess
text: She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.

title: Rested a Short Time
text: … except that she rested a short time in the shelter.

title: Stay Close to My Servant Girls
text: Do not go and glean in another field … but stay here close to my servant girls.

title: Jars the Young Men Have Filled
text: And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.

title: Even Though I Am a Foreigner
text: Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?

title: Under Whose Wings
text: … the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.

title: Some Left Over
text: … and she ate and was satisfied and had some left over.

title: Do Not Insult Her
text: Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.

title: Leave Stalks for Her
text: Rather, pull out for her some stalks from the bundles and leave them for her to gather.

title: About an Ephah of Barley
text: And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.

title: Until Evening
text: So Ruth gathered grain in the field until evening.

title: She Gave It to Naomi
text: And she brought out what she had saved from her meal and gave it to Naomi.

title: Blessed Be the Man
text: Blessed be the man who noticed you.

title: One of Our Kinsman-Redeemers
text: The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers.

title: Until the Harvests Were Finished
text: So Ruth stayed close to the servant girls of Boaz to glean grain until the barley and wheat harvests were finished.

title: Fellow Citizens
text: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,

title: A Faithful Worker
text: … except that she rested a short time in the shelter.

title: Close to the Servant Girls
text: … stay here close to my servant girls.

title: Mara
text: Call me Mara, because the Almighty has dealt quite bitterly with me.

title: Moabite Women
text: … who took Moabite women as their wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth.
